hypotheses.title: Inverted drive logic (code level vs wiring polarity)
hypotheses.explanation: Ghost LED (GPIO19) changed state when commanded — so the signal path works — but ended in the wrong state. The manifest declares active-low wiring; the code drives HIGH for 'on'. That is a confirmed polarity inversion. Model check (inferred): the shadow reproduces the observed signature with this fault — consistent within our fault model, not measured.
